features.match: 100% of the first 1% of pay + 50% of the next 5%
features.matchText: The Company is required to make QACA basic matching contributions to the Plan equal to 100% of the first 1% of a participant's salary deferral contributions and 50% of the next 5% of a participant's salary deferral contributions.
features.vestingText: Vesting schedule as filed — less than 2: 0%, 2 or more: 100%
features.rothText: Participants may designate all or a portion of their salary deferral contributions as Roth deferral contributions.
features.eligibilityText: General The Plan is a defined contribution retirement plan covering all eligible employees of AMG Enterprises LLC (the "Company") who have attained age 21 and completed one month of service, as defined by the Plan.
features.loansText: 7 AMG Enterprises LLC 401(k) Notes receivable from participants Participants may borrow from their fund accounts a minimum of $1,000 up to a maximum equal to the lesser of $50,000 or 50% of their vested account balance.
features.autoEnrollText: Automatically enrolled participants have their pre-tax deferral rate set at 3% of eligible compensation, with annual 1% increases up to a maximum deferral rate of 6%, and their contributions invested in a designated balanced fund until changed by the participant.

features.matchText: Employer discretionary matching contributions and nonelective contributions are determined annually by the Employers.
features.vestingText: The method for crediting vesting service for Company matching and profit sharing contributions is based on vesting periods of service.
features.rothText: Elective deferrals, roth deferrals, Employer profit sharing, and rollover contributions are allowed by the Plan.
features.eligibilityText: All employees of the Company and any participating affiliates are subject to eligibility requirements of six months of service.
features.autoEnrollText: The Plan has an automatic enrollment provision (3% salary deferral with 1% increases annually as of the first day of each Plan year until reaching a maximum of 6%) whereby employees must elect out of the Plan if they do not wish to participate.
